original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical CUDA.jl genuinely uses cuBLAS LU, but calls strided-batched wrapper with allocation of pivot/info outputs within ROI, whereas native uses pointer-array batched API with preallocated outputs. The study aligns raw pointer-array API, preallocation, pinned library and context-wide completion for all models. RNG inputs differ historically; all four consume an identical fully initialized named fixture. No historical wrong LU computation is established.
